units.function: Tests for UTC monthly boundaries and intended PostgreSQL-backed 14-day Run activity/recovery projections.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> dashboard service -> Paperclip DB schema and embedded PostgreSQL when supported; no API authorization, realtime event stream, responsibility projection or Web layer.
units.keyDataModels: Company, Agent, heartbeat Run status/error/retry links/createdAt and daily succeeded/failed/recovered/other/error-code buckets.
units.lifecycle: Runs and retries accumulate -> summary queries a rolling UTC window -> recovery chains reclassify process-loss failures -> per-day operational buckets are returned.
units.testAssessment: Only the UTC helper test executed and passed; both embedded-PostgreSQL tests skipped in sandboxed and approved unsandboxed runs. Intended fixtures thoughtfully cover tenant isolation, >100 Runs, full-window aggregation and chained recovery, but the database projection is unverified in this environment and lacks performance/freshness/evolution cases.
units.designRationale: Give operators an accurate operational trend instead of a truncated recent-Run sample and distinguish self-healed infrastructure restarts from actionable failures.
units.companyOsProblem: Agent Boss needs trustworthy projections for work outcomes, execution attempts, waiting/blocked/approval states, failures/recovery, cost and responsibility evidence with explicit freshness.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the complete-window, tenant-negative and retry-chain test patterns. Build Company OS projections from canonical work/execution/evidence events; separate attempt counts from unique work outcomes, expose asOf/watermark/version, retain stable error families and include accountable human, approval, data/tool grant, cost and evidence-completeness dimensions.
units.responsibilityConflict: The dashboard counts Run attempts and recovery mechanics but cannot answer who requested or owned the Work, who approved risk, which permissions/data were used or whether a successful Run produced accepted evidence/result. It is operational telemetry, not the responsibility system of record.
evidence: 2026-08-19 sandboxed and approved unsandboxed focused Vitest: 1 passed, 2 embedded-PostgreSQL tests skipped
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL verification gap: the only tenant-isolation and recovery-classification database tests did not execute. HIGH semantic risk: totals mix failed attempts, recovered attempts and successful retries rather than unique accountable outcomes. MEDIUM stability risk: unknown/new statuses fall into coarse buckets without a versioned projection contract; no asOf/watermark exposes staleness. Missing tests include cross-tenant retry links, retry cycles, late events, clock skew, pagination/query plans/indexes and authorization.
